QueryInterval.description: A half-open interval in one explicitly named source clock, in exact nanoseconds.

ReviewQuery.description: One of the maintained queries; callers cannot provide arbitrary commands.

oneOf.description: Completed inclusive intervals and their clipped union per capture-local track.
Source numerical events; typed native inputs remain full-UInt64 authority.
Reported trace errors/loss, not proof of capture completeness.

ReviewQueryColumn.description: A declared output column; strings preserve canonical native integer text.

kind.description: Integer, number or text; Perfetto integers are signed, never full UInt64.

ReviewQueryRequest.description: Explicit optional query request, separate from a scientific operation.

clock_scope.description: Source clock name, scoped to this capture.

input_member.description: Exact selected capture/member identity; not an original-path lookup hint.

interval.description: Requested interval, or whole supplied capture.

output_bytes.description: Finite combined stdout/stderr extent; metadata has a separate bounded extent.

timeout_seconds.description: Finite positive child lifetime in seconds.

ReviewQueryStatus.description: Status never conflates absent/failed output with empty success.

oneOf.description: One well-formed result set, possibly empty.
Optional tool or input was not available.
Caller clock elapsed; exact child was joined.
Explicit caller interruption; exact child was joined.
Successful process did not produce the declared single CSV result schema.

description: Retained query product, including readable failure prefixes and interpretation limits.

columns.description: Schema expected from this query, not inferred from returned data.

covered_interval.description: Interval actually covered by source metadata, if supplied/known.

exit_code.description: Exact process exit status, absent if no process was started.

limitations.description: Source gaps, clock limits, unsupported arithmetic and output omissions.

output.description: Relative private output path and readable bytes, even on failure.

output_prefix_bytes.description: Actual retained bytes, not necessarily complete CSV rows on failure.

query_version.description: Maintained query revision, independent of tool release.

rows.description: Decoded rows only after successful schema validation; no count on failure.

sql.description: Exact executed SQL, including interval parameters.

tool_version.description: Actual `--version` output, unavailable rather than declared pin substitution.
